## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Change request

- Helpdesk ticket / issue:
- Content owner approval, if applicable:

## Review checklist

- [ ] Change is limited to approved scope
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, internal-only configuration, or protected data were added
- [ ] Site builds successfully
- [ ] Links added or modified were verified
- [ ] Responsive behavior was checked
- [ ] Keyboard navigation was checked for affected interactive elements
- [ ] Heading structure and semantic HTML were reviewed
- [ ] Images have appropriate alt text or are decorative
- [ ] Color contrast and visible focus were considered
- [ ] No unnecessary client-side framework or JavaScript was added
- [ ] Documentation was updated if architecture, build, deployment, or governance changed

## Testing performed

List build, lint, accessibility, link, or manual checks performed.

## Notes for reviewer

List any content questions, known limitations, or follow-up items.
